name: Sika ViscoCrete PC HRF-2
paste:
SIKA® VISCOCRETE® PC HRF-2: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2, July 2024, Version 01.05 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sika_viscocrete_pchrf-2.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2024, Version 01.05).
1.2 Product description. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2 is a third generation High Range Water Reducer specifically designed for the production of concrete which requires high early strength characteristics and enhanced workability retention.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2 is suitable for the production of concrete mixes which require extended workability retention , (for a target slump of greater than 160mm the product is capable of maintaining workability within the tolerances set by AS1379-2007 for up to 45 minutes.), high early strength, high water reduction, improved workability and off shutter finish characteristics. It is ideally suited for use in:
    - Precast concrete (due to the workability retention properties this can also be batched off site)
    - Post tensioned applications
    - High early strength applications
    - High strength concrete
    - Self compacting concrete (SCC)

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: HIGH RANGE WATER REDUCER
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2 is a high-range water reducing admixture meeting the requirements of AS1478.1 – 2000 Type HWR
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS1379-2007: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Uses (p.1).
    - AS1478.1: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2 effectively achieves the following benefits:
    - High density and impermeable concrete through high water reduction.
    - Improved workability and finishing.
    - Pronounced increase in the early strength development.
    - Increased characteristic strengths.
    - Increased durability of the concrete
    - Optimised cement utilisation
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Aqueous solution of modified polycarboxilates.
    - Appearance and colour: Clear light brown liquid.
    - Density: 1.08 kg/l approximately
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk deliveries; 1000 litre IBC; 10 litre container
    - Shelf life: Stored at temperature between 5°C and 35°C in unopened original containers protected from direct sunlight and frost, shelf life is one (1) year.
    - Storage conditions: Store at temperature between 5°C and 35 °C, protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2024, Version 01.05) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2024, Version 01.05) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. Typical dosage rates range from 200 – 1000ml per 100kg of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage depends on the type of concrete, site conditions, mix proportions, ingredients and desired plastic and hardened concrete properties. Laboratory and/or field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage.
4.3 Dispensing. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2 is added to the initial batching water. For optimum utilisation of the high water reduction we recommend thorough mixing at a minimal wet mixing time of 60 seconds per cubic meter. The addition of the remaining gauging water, to fine tune concrete consistency, should only be started after 2/3 of the wet mixing time, to avoid surplus water in the concrete. Do not add Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2 to dry mix.
4.4 Compatibility. Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2 can be used in conjunction with all Sika Concrete Admixtures, with the exception of Sikament® NN. All Admixtures must be added separately and trials are recommnended before use.
4.5 Further documentation.
    - May slightly increase air content of concrete.
    - Do not use with naphtalene based admixtures.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2024, Version 01.05) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2, July 2024, Version 01.05, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/sika_viscocrete_pchrf-2.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika ViscoCrete PC HRF2, version 22/07/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/MSDS%20Sika%C2%AE%20ViscoCrete%C2%AE%20PC%20HRF2%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF2, version 04/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/s/sds-sika-viscocretepchrf2.pdf
    - Environmental Product Declaration: EPD Sika® ViscoCrete® PC HRF-2, version 12/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/epd-sika-viscocretepchrf-2.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
